rule_changes.title: No SG Arrival Card without a valid Singapore VEP
rule_changes.body: From 6 October 2026, a Malaysian-registered car cannot complete the SG Arrival Card unless it already holds a valid Singapore Vehicle Entry Permit from LTA. The permit needs Singapore motor insurance, so sort both before the trip.

rule_changes.title: Unpaid Singapore fines block VEP renewal and entry
rule_changes.body: From 2 November 2026, a foreign-registered vehicle with unpaid Singapore traffic, parking or emissions fines cannot apply for or renew its VEP and will be refused entry at Woodlands and Tuas.

rule_changes.title: RTS Link opening now expected in February 2027
rule_changes.body: The Straits Times reported on 2 October 2026 that the Johor Bahru to Woodlands North rail link is now expected to open in February 2027 instead of December 2026. Government pages still carried the December 2026 target as of 30 September 2026. Five minutes station to station, up to 10,000 passengers an hour each way, immigration for both countries cleared at the departure station.

standing_rules.title: Johor's weekend is Saturday and Sunday
standing_rules.body: Johor moved its rest days back to Saturday and Sunday on 1 January 2025, so both sides of the Causeway now share the same weekend.

standing_rules.title: Malaysia enforces its own VEP on Singapore cars
standing_rules.body: Singapore-registered vehicles need a Malaysian VEP tag to enter Johor. Enforcement began in phases from 1 October 2024.

standing_rules.title: Live traffic by phone
standing_rules.body: ICA's CHECK-TIPS hotline for the checkpoint traffic situation is 6863 0117.

single_day.note: Record single-day crossings at Woodlands and Tuas combined, beating 589,000 on 19 December 2025.
